title: Produce share pickup
brief:
Complete the following real project in the current, initially empty directory. Choose the deliverables, media, tools, structure and implementation that serve the intended user. Build usable artifacts and check your work. Deliver the project itself. Omit personally identifying credits, author signatures and model or toolchain identity labels. No network access or credentials are provided.

Design a pickup experience for a neighborhood produce share serving 64 households from a community center lobby. Members enter through one door, collect a standard or small box, and may exchange one item at a swap table. Six volunteers rotate through shifts, and some members read limited English. The lobby has a single 8-foot table, two folding stands, and an 11-by-17-inch printer. Create a coordinated set of materials that members and volunteers can use on pickup day. Start from an empty directory and choose the deliverables, tools, and file layout. Use original graphics and make the materials usable offline.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="17in" height="11in" viewBox="0 0 1224 792">
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1224" height="792" rx="0" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none" stroke-width="1"/>
<g transform="translate(35 26) scale(0.4)">
<path d="M39 33 Q19 26 19 8 Q37 8 42 29 Q38 10 51 0 Q61 16 47 33 Q57 15 72 19 Q68 34 48 37" fill="#38653E" stroke="#193837" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

</g>
<text x="76" y="53" font-family="Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">NEIGHBORHOOD PRODUCE SHARE</text>
<text x="1180" y="53" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end" fill="#193837">VOLUNTEER GUIDE   /   KEEP AT PICKUP</text>
<path d="M44 74 H1180" fill="none" stroke="#193837" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="44" y="141" font-family="Georgia" font-size="61" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Set the lobby</text>
<text x="46" y="184" font-family="Arial" font-size="23" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Place the entry stand inside, clear of the door swing. Keep a return lane to the same door.</text>
<rect x="44" y="217" width="1136" height="249" rx="15" fill="#F6EEE0" stroke="none" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="70" y="252" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">STAFF SIDE</text>
<text x="202" y="252" font-family="Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Keep reserve boxes on the staff side. Refill in small batches.</text>
<rect x="77" y="274" width="380" height="86" rx="0" fill="#E9F0E3" stroke="#193837" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="94" y="311" font-family="Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">36 in   Standard</text>
<text x="94" y="341" font-family="Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Square tent</text>
<rect x="457" y="274" width="380" height="86" rx="0" fill="#F8E8DE" stroke="#193837" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="474" y="311" font-family="Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">36 in   Small</text>
<text x="474" y="341" font-family="Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Triangle tent</text>
<rect x="837" y="274" width="307" height="86" rx="0" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#193837" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="854" y="311" font-family="Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">24 in   Swap</text>
<text x="854" y="341" font-family="Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Loose items only</text>
<text x="75" y="395" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">1   ENTRY STAND</text>
<g transform="translate(259 377) scale(0.75)">
<path d="M0 8 H38 V0 L56 15 L38 30 V22 H0Z" fill="#193837" stroke="none" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
</g>
<text x="490" y="395" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">2   BOX PICKUP</text>
<g transform="translate(740 377) scale(0.75)">
<path d="M0 8 H38 V0 L56 15 L38 30 V22 H0Z" fill="#193837" stroke="none" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
</g>
<text x="866" y="395" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">3   SWAP STAND</text>
<text x="75" y="439" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Member side  •  Keep the waiting line to one side. Mirror the layout to suit the door.</text>
<text x="44" y="526" font-family="Georgia" font-size="33" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Before opening</text>
<text x="642" y="526" font-family="Georgia" font-size="33" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">During pickup</text>
<text x="45" y="567" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Print pages 1–5 single-sided on 11 × 17 in paper.</text>
<text x="45" y="595" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Put pages 1 and 2 on stands by entry and swap.</text>
<text x="45" y="623" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Cut page 3 at the center dashed line. Fold each half</text>
<text x="45" y="651" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">at the middle dots, then fold both feet outward.</text>
<text x="45" y="679" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Place tents by matching stacks. Seed the swap end</text>
<text x="45" y="707" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">with share stock. Bring a pen and record opening counts.</text>
<text x="643" y="567" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Split six volunteers into two crews of three.</text>
<text x="643" y="595" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Welcome leads the shift and asks for box size.</text>
<text x="643" y="623" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Boxes hands out one box and marks the tally.</text>
<text x="643" y="651" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Swap supports one optional give-one, take-one trade.</text>
<text x="643" y="679" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">Keep the exit route clear. If a size runs out, pause</text>
<text x="643" y="707" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#193837">that size and ask the shift lead before substituting.</text>
</svg>

NEIGHBORHOOD PRODUCE SHARE
Pickup day kit

Open Print/Pickup day.pdf in a local PDF reader. Print one copy,
single-sided, at actual size on landscape 17 × 11 inch (tabloid) paper.
Color or grayscale works. Allow time to cut and fold the two size tents.
Bring scissors and a pen. A small piece of tape on each tent foot can
help it stay in place on a slick table.

1  Entry stand       Members can point to their box size here.
2  Swap stand        Place alongside the optional exchange area.
3  Two table tents   Cut on the dashed line. Fold on the dotted lines.
4  Setup guide       Use for the lobby layout and volunteer briefing.
5  Pickup tally      Share one sheet across both shifts. Circle one size
                     per box issued. Count the circled sizes at close.

The member signs use English and Spanish, with pictures and matching
shapes for pointing. Editable/ contains one self-contained SVG per page
for local language or layout changes. The PDF embeds its fonts.

# Neighborhood produce share pickup kit

Print one copy of each PDF and use the kit in the lobby for a 64-household pickup. The member materials pair English and Spanish with matching pictures. Spanish is the second language used in this kit because no member language list was supplied. Volunteers can use the pictures and box signs with anyone who prefers to point.

| File | Print | Put it to work |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Member signs](print/01-member-signs.pdf) | 3 sheets, 11 × 17 in, single-sided. Pages 1–2 portrait, page 3 landscape. | Place the entry and swap posters on the two stands. Cut the three signs on page 3 and lay them face up toward members or attach them to the table edge. |
| [Swap tickets](print/02-swap-tickets.pdf) | 1 sheet, 11 × 17 in, portrait. | Cut on the dashed grid for 64 tickets. Place the stack with the box volunteer. |
| [Volunteer kit](print/03-volunteer-kit.pdf) | 5 sheets, US Letter, single-sided. If the printer is loaded with 11 × 17 paper, print centered at 100%. | Read the first two pages before setup. Fill the two roster pages and the shift and count sheet before opening. Keep all five pages behind the table. |

Choose **Actual size / 100%** and auto-orient, or print the landscape sign page separately. Color is optional. The signs use words and distinct pictures so black-and-white copies still work. Set out a pen, scissors and the organizer’s current household list. Tape is optional.

The layout diagram assumes the entrance can also serve as the exit. Confirm the exit and queue space with center staff, then turn or mirror the layout to preserve a clear route and door swing. The kit uses three active roles across two shifts. The opening count, household assignments and pickup times are filled in on site.

The PDFs contain their fonts and graphics and can be opened and printed offline. The editable layout and artwork are in [source/make-kit.swift](source/make-kit.swift). To regenerate the PDFs on macOS with Swift installed, run `swift source/make-kit.swift` from this directory.
